description: Ice-blue spires on a common base, cold indoors and out. Rimeshard grows this in its rock and swings the rest.
lore: The test is your own neck. Hold a spire under the jaw for a slow count of twenty. True frost quartz does not come up to meet you — it stays precisely as cold as it was, and afterwards the skin aches. Dyed quartz warms by about eight. An honest seller offers you the count before you ask for it.

The forgers got around this in the obvious way. They sell in hard weather, when everything in the world is cold and the count proves nothing, and they sell to people three weeks out of [[lore/the_waking|the grass]], who do not yet know that anything here is bought or sold, and who will hand over a coin they carried through an entire life for a stone that is going to disappoint them in April.
